caption.opening: We all hope for mercy. This hadith asks us to start giving it.
body: Sahih al-Bukhari 6013 is one line long and asks a lot of us.

Try this today:
→ be patient with someone who is slow
→ forgive one small wrong without mentioning it
→ be gentle with children and animals

claims.text: What bukhari:6013 says, quoted verbatim on screen.
Patience, quiet forgiveness and gentleness are ways to act on the hadith.
